subject: PO onboarding: Lexicon Health — invoicing cadence & net75 constraints
messages:
From: Sara Ward <sara.ward@lexiconhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@lexiconhealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Lexicon PO 4521 — billing requirements & onboarding asks

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — Lexicon Procurement is ready to onboard Redwood against PO #4521. Before our finance team releases the PO we need confirmation on a few mandatory billing items so we can set up AR mappings and the ERP ingest. Please confirm whether Redwood can meet the following: 

1) PO on every invoice: the PO number must appear in the invoice header and be present in the PDF filename (e.g., Redwood_Invoice_PO4521_YYYYMM.pdf).
2) Net terms: Lexicon operates on net75 for third-party SaaS vendors of this category. We need written acceptance of net75.
3) Invoice cadence: Procurement prefers a consolidated monthly statement that lists all charges and ties each line back to PO line-items. If monthly is not possible, we can accept weekly invoices only if each invoice includes a CSV (or EDI 810) export for automated ingestion.
4) Attachment/format: provide a sample CSV layout and confirm whether you can include both PDF and machine-readable CSV with each invoicing run.
5) Discount triggers: any pricing concessions must be explicitly tied to commitment bands and recorded in the SOW/contract. Procurement cannot accept informal discounts via email.

I've attached the PO (Lexicon_PO_4521.pdf) and our AP contact list for reference. Our AP team will need Redwood's remittance details and the person who will handle invoice follow-ups.

Can you reply by EOD Thursday so our AP can finish the vendor setup?

Thanks,
Sara Ward
Vendor Operations | Lexicon Health
Sara.Ward@lexiconhealth.com
Attachment: Lexicon_PO_4521.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Ward <sara.ward@lexiconhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Lexicon PO 4521 — billing requirements & onboarding asks

Hi Sara — great to hear the PO is ready, and thanks for the clear list. Quick responses below and a proposed path to avoid any hold-up on vendor setup: 

1) PO on every invoice: yes — we will include the PO number in the PDF header and filename. We'll use the pattern you suggested.

2) Net terms: Redwood standard is net30, but we can accommodate net75 for enterprise customers with an approved AR arrangement. To finalize this we will need an approved SOW signature and the PO on file; I can flag this as a billing exception to finance once legal confirms SOW language.

3) Invoice cadence: we can produce a consolidated monthly statement by default. As an alternate, we can provide weekly invoice batches that include a machine-readable CSV for ERP ingestion. The weekly option requires an internal mapping for PO line items — we can deliver that as part of onboarding.

4) Attachment/format: attaching our sample invoice CSV (Redwood_Invoice_Template.csv) — it maps invoice line -> PO line -> usage window. We can also produce EDI 810 if you require it; that will take an extra week to test.

5) Discount triggers: understood — any discounts tied to commitment bands will be documented in the SOW/contract. If Lexicon is open to a 6-month committed minimum (usage or spend), we can offer a one-time onboarding credit or a 3% consumption discount — we will formalize this in the commercial schedule.

Next steps I propose: (a) confirm whether monthly consolidated statements are acceptable (fastest path), (b) if Lexicon needs net75, please confirm and we will start the internal approval (finance + legal), and (c) provide AP mapping requirements for the CSV/EDI so our billing team can align fields.

I'll loop in Vanessa (AM) for billing ops and Marissa (Finance) for remittance setup.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Template.csv, Lexicon_AP-terms.docx

From: Sara Ward <sara.ward@lexiconhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@lexiconhealth.com, ap-team@lexiconhealth.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Lexicon PO 4521 — billing requirements & onboarding asks

Hi Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the sample CSV. A few clarifications from Procurement / AP: 

- Monthly consolidated statement is our preference — that keeps our AR aging clean. Please confirm you will send a single PDF statement monthly and include a CSV attachment with each statement that maps to our ERP fields.

- Net75: procurement policy is firm for vendors of this size/contract type — we require written acceptance before the PO can be processed. Lexicon cannot commit to prepayment-based discounts (e.g., 6-month prepay) on this workflow; those are separate commercial negotiations and will need to be handled by the Legal/Commercial teams.

- PO on invoice filename and header: required.

- EDI/CSV mapping: AP needs the CSV column list to map to our vendor-side fields. The attached PO contains line-item references and GL codes. Please include a sample invoice file that shows the PO reference in both the human-readable PDF and the CSV row.

- Remittance: please provide the remittance contact (email + phone) and bank wiring instructions for our vendor record.

If Redwood can sign off on net75 in writing and confirm monthly consolidated statements with CSV attachments, Procurement will clear the PO next week.

Best,
Sara Ward
Vendor Operations | Lexicon Health
Attachment: Lexicon_PO_4521.pdf (re-sent)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Ward <sara.ward@lexiconhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Lexicon PO 4521 — billing requirements & onboarding asks

Sara — thanks and understood. Confirmations and next steps below: 

1) Net75: Redwood accepts net75 for PO #4521. This acceptance is contingent on receipt of the signed SOW and the PO being present in our vendor onboarding portal; we will provide a formal acceptance letter for your records (cc Marissa).

2) Invoice cadence/format: Redwood will issue a consolidated monthly statement (single PDF) that includes a line-by-line breakdown tied to PO line-items. Each monthly statement will be accompanied by a machine-readable CSV (attached sample: Redwood_Invoice_Template.csv). The CSV includes columns: invoice_id, invoice_date, po_number, po_line_id, sku, usage_start, usage_end, quantity, unit_price, line_total, gl_code.

3) PO in filename/header: we will follow the filename pattern Redwood_Invoice_PO4521_YYYYMM.pdf and include the PO in the invoice header.

4) EDI/other: we can support EDI 810 if required — please confirm and the team will schedule a short EDI onboarding call. EDI provisioning may add one week.

5) Remittance and AR contact: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai) will be the remittance lead and primary contact for invoice escalations. Vanessa will coordinate the onboarding of the CSV mapping to ensure field parity with Lexicon ERP. Bank wiring details will be provided in the vendor portal once the vendor record is created (security reasons).

6) Discounts and commercial: understood that discounts require SOW/contract language. If Lexicon wants to explore a consumption discount in exchange for a committed minimum, we will route that to Commercial for a formal amendment.

Next steps: 
- I will upload the signed acceptance into the deal page (https://redwood.app/sales/deals/LH-2026-0943).
- Vanessa will reach out to your AP team to validate the CSV schema and schedule any EDI test windows.
- Marissa will submit the formal acceptance note for net75 to Procurement and attach to the PO record.

If that meets Procurement's needs, please confirm and we'll mark the vendor as approved so the PO can be invoiced next billing cycle.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz (AM) <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole (Finance) <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Template.csv
